title: Crypto Trading Signals - September 09, 2026
top_story_headline: Jack Dorsey’s Block applies for an OCC national trust bank charter, seeking to offer custody and fiduciary services for Bitcoin, stablecoins and other assets
top_story_comment: Block already has an FDIC-insured Utah industrial bank: Square Financial Services originates Cash App Borrow and Square Loans, while Builders Bank would take no deposits and make no loans. The two-charter stack separates credit from crypto custody and puts the custody side in the federal lane the OCC conditionally approved for Circle, Ripple, Paxos, BitGo and Fidelity Digital Assets on December 12, 2025.
